decision: Converge galway/muckross/kinsale on main: merge deploy/fleet-latest-2026-09 and #501 (web plane mounts the Docker socket, fleet-wide), and let scripts/deploy.sh take DAAX_IMAGE_OVERRIDE/DAAX_TERMINAL_IMAGE_OVERRIDE (digest-only) over the sourced env file's pins.
rationale: Hosts tracked a per-host branch that main did not contain. The operator chose #501 fleet-wide on 2026-09-13 knowing the web plane becomes root-equivalent on the host. The env file is sourced after the caller's environment, so without *_OVERRIDE a fleet roller's digest was overwritten by the pin and every host silently redeployed what it already ran.
alternatives: docker-socket-proxy for the web plane (narrower; deferred)
keep hosts on the fleet branch (rejected: no single source)
have the fleet roller rewrite env files mid-deploy (rejected: unreviewed on-disk drift)
validation: producer Claude Opus 5; validator gpt-5.6-sol; r1 found 1 P1 (digest rollback), 2 P2, 2 P3 — all fixed with tests
